Visible titles include: 'Think and Grow Rich' (Napoleon Hill), 'Atomic Habits' (James Clear), 'The Psychology of Money' (Morgan Housel), 'The Power of Focus' (Jack Canfield), 'Sell Like Crazy' (Sabri Suby), 'Mindset' (Carol S. Dweck), 'Billionaire' (Joe Girard), 'Rich Dad' (Robert T. Kiyosaki) and 'Increase Your Financial IQ' (Robert T. Kiyosaki).
No photo shows ISBNs, edition years, publisher pages, or the back covers.

claims.claim: Get 5 copies of good books for 20k & 10 copies for 33k.
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not confirm quantity (5 vs 10) or the exact bundle composition.

claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints.
claims.evidence: Photos show book spines only; no ISBN/edition/publisher pages or close-ups of print quality to verify originality.
Photos do not show inside pages or any open-book view.
This is a slogan; photos do not validate it.

risks.risk: Bundle quantity mismatch (seller may be offering fewer/more than 5 or 10, or different titles than shown).
risks.proof: A photo showing the exact count laid out (5 or 10 books) with titles visible, plus a list of all titles included.
risks.if_unproven: Price the bundle at worst-case as fewer/less complete than promised (treat as not meeting the stated quantity).

risks.risk: Not original editions (could be reprints/photocopies or wrong editions).
risks.proof: Clear photos of ISBN/edition/publisher page (copyright page) for at least 2–3 representative books, and back-cover photos.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not verified originality (treat as reprint/unknown edition).

risks.proof: Open-book photos showing the first pages and a random interior page for at least 2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there may be writing (treat as used with possible markings).

risks.risk: Condition issues (missing pages, torn covers, water damage, heavy wear).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cover corners, spine condition, and a page showing any damage for at least 2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for used condition (assume wear consistent with second-hand).

proof_requests: Confirm whether the bundle is exactly 5 or exactly 10 copies for the stated option, and show a photo with the exact count laid out.
Send photos of the copyright/ISBN page for at least 2–3 books (to verify original editions vs reprints).
Send open photos of inside pages (first page + one random interior page) for at least 2 books to confirm no writing/highlighting.
Send close-ups of cover/spine and any potential damage for at least 2 books.
response.reason: The photos show book titles but do not verify the seller’s key conditions (original vs reprint, no writing inside) or the exact bundle quantity/composition. Without those proofs, pricing would be guesswork.
